# Contributing to Signet

This guide is the developer entry point for the `signetai/` Bun monorepo. For using Signet as a product, start with the [Quickstart](https://docs.signetai.sh/quickstart/).

New to GitHub? Follow [Your First PR](https://docs.signetai.sh/first-pr/).

## Set up the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Signet-AI/signetai.git
cd signetai
bun install
bun run hooks:install
bun run build
bun test
```

Before submitting a change, run:

```bash
bun run typecheck
bun run lint
bun run format
bun test
```

The pre-commit hook runs staged Biome validation and the workspace typecheck. Run it directly with `bun run hooks:pre-commit`.

## Find your way around

- `platform/` — runtime, core, daemon, and native packages
- `surfaces/` — CLI, dashboard, desktop, tray, and browser extension
- `integrations/` — harness connectors and plugins
- `libs/` — SDK and reusable connector libraries
- `plugins/` — Signet-native plugins
- `web/` — marketing site and documentation
- `memorybench/` — benchmark harness and UI

The daemon owns core application behavior and durable transitions. Read the nearest package documentation and trace the affected path before changing it.

## Development loops

```bash
bun run build
bun test platform/daemon/src/pipeline/worker.test.ts
cd platform/daemon && bun run dev
cd web/marketing && bun run dev
```

Bun is the package manager. TypeScript uses the repository's strict configuration. Use Biome for linting and formatting, keep changes focused, and explain non-obvious decisions in comments.

Use Conventional Commits with an imperative subject of 50 characters or fewer. Keep the body within 72 columns. Use `docs:` for documentation changes.

## Pull requests

Describe the behavior changed, the evidence used, and the checks you ran. Keep unrelated work out of the PR. UI changes must include screenshots.

AI tools are welcome, but contributors remain responsible for understanding and reviewing every change. Disclose AI assistance in the PR and include `Assisted-by` tags in commit messages as described in [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Signet-AI/signetai/blob/main/AI_POLICY.md). Every PR receives human review.

Signet's release workflow is automated; do not publish packages manually.
